convention_rule: Four signals map to four candidates; the single green (go) signal marks the target by its 1-based left-to-right position, read as the candidate ID number.
basis: Both A and B show four rail signals with only the third from the left green and the rest red. Position 3 read as P3 (not the client-correct P4). Ambiguous: if position follows the listed order (P3,P1,P2,P4), it would point to P2 instead.
